decisions.what: Implementation runs on branch `pipeline` in the main checkout, not a linked worktree.
decisions.why: The build depends on live per-checkout state a worktree cannot share: x-agent/mcp/node_modules + dist, tools/node_modules, and tools/.runtime Playground descriptors. Tree was clean at branch time; isolation is by branch.

decisions.what: pipeline/ is plain ESM .mjs importing x-agent/mcp/dist directly (no TypeScript, no build step, no new npm deps); unit tests run on node:test; JSON-Schema checks use a minimal in-repo draft-07 subset validator.
decisions.why: The spec's environment says the pipeline imports dist; proof/ set the deps-free precedent; the house rule is no ajv (x-agent/tests/schemas.test.ts) and zod is not resolvable from repo root without a new node_modules.

decisions.what: S3's dry-run drift gate fails only on diff kind=value_differs in spacing.spacingSizes/layout groups; missing_on_instance entries there are ignored.
decisions.why: wp_get_global_settings serves origin-keyed spacingSizes ({default,theme}) which the emitter's differ (array-indexed) reports wholesale as missing_on_instance even for a byte-perfect pass-through; value_differs is the only kind that means an instance value would actually change. The byte-equality of the pass-through itself is asserted locally in tokenChecks.

decisions.what: Acceptance playgrounds boot programmatically on a dedicated 'pipeline-accept' slot (accept/_playground.mjs holder) at port 9410.
decisions.why: The boot CLI has no --slot flag and the default core-only-toolchain slot was held by the owner's persistent live instance on 9400, which must never be stopped or reused.

decisions.what: S5/S6 with zero declared blocks/packages are real no-ops (they initialize their artifact maps and return); W_STYLE_UNKNOWN fails a tree artifact like W_ATTR_UNKNOWN.
decisions.why: B=0/P=0 briefs must flow through the fixed stage list without factory work — the empty fan-out IS the correct behavior, not a placeholder. An is-style-* unregistered at the current fingerprint is an invented style; the spec's mechanical screen names only W_ATTR_UNKNOWN and W_STATIC_NEEDS_HARNESS, so the conservative reading fails the unknown style and the repair lane owns it.

decisions.what: S9 verifies on a FRESH session: wp_disconnect first, then wp_verify/wp_screenshot; run.mjs holds a keepalive interval and flags event-loop drains.
decisions.why: Observed repeatedly: after S8's install-triggered epoch reloads + the image pass, the warm session can be left dead-but-cached — wp_verify then pends forever with zero chromium children, and without a keepalive the drained event loop exits 0 mid-run, masquerading as success. Standalone verify of the same URL is clean. Toolchain backlog: dead-session detection in sessionFor.

decisions.what: S2 converts pattern parsed_tree from Gutenberg parse shape (blockName/attrs, whitespace nodes) to TreeIR node shape before it enters payloads or baselines.
decisions.why: The model copies whatever idiom it is shown — parse-shaped patterns caused systematic schema_failed retries (blockName/attrs echoed back); and an S7 pattern baseline in parse shape would die at S8's wp_validate. Mechanical key mapping, not authorship.

decisions.what: Per-section heading discipline rides in the tree payload (hero: the page's single h1 with attributes.level 1 EXPLICIT; other sections: h2 top, h3 items) and S9 fails on outline jumps.
decisions.why: core/heading defaults to level 2; without the rule the verifier caught real outlines with zero h1s and h1->h3 jumps. Authoring-side prevention keeps the strict verify gate meaningful.

decisions.what: Concurrent factory gates get deterministic distinct sandbox ports (blocks 9440+2i, packages 9460+2i), reused by S7 repairs.
decisions.why: Three concurrent wp_block_build_test calls racing for 'first free port' 9440 crashed a smoke sandbox ('exited with code 1 without writing a result'), killing an innocent artifact. Port assignment is pipeline plumbing, not a toolchain change — the tools accept {port}.

decisions.what: Pattern baselines are gated: S7 wp_validates a substituted pattern baseline and degrades to the minimal core/group slot on failure; content-context patterns (comments/query/post-template) are excluded from S2 pattern picking.
decisions.why: A comments-thread pattern was picked as a stats-section baseline and failed final-epoch validation, killing the whole run in S8 — a baseline that cannot pass the same gate is not a baseline. Both fixes are mechanical selection/validation, not authorship.

decisions.what: Temptation log: three places invited extra retries and were held to the bound — (a) S3's dry-run gate failing after the schema-retry was burned ends the run rather than regenerating tokens; (b) S7 repairs run with maxAttempts 1, so a malformed repair output is immediately dead; (c) sandbox-boot crashes in build tests burn the artifact's single repair even though they are infrastructure failures — the port isolation removed the known cause rather than adding a retry.
decisions.why: The bounds held in every accepted run; the ceilings were never the binding constraint (13/23 on the full-scope run). Recording per the spec's progress protocol.

decisions.what: Added the x-pipeline CLI (pipeline/cli.mjs + root ./x-pipeline wrapper): site new/connect/status/stop, config init, build — one command from nothing to a published site (build --new-site auto-writes pipeline.config.json from stored provider keys and boots a companion Playground). The acceptance boot holder moved to pipeline/lib/site-holder.mjs.
decisions.why: The manual path (boot holder, jq-merge .x-agent.json, hand-write pipeline.config.json) was operator hostile. The CLI writes only the files the pipeline already reads (.x-agent.json mode 0600, pipeline.config.json, tools/.runtime descriptors) — no new state, no toolchain surface; site connect verifies with wp_connect before writing and warns on production posture.
